shared_elements: long curving linear forms that could read as serpent/boat-like outlines
rows of repeated short strokes or comb-like marks
justification: The most specific overlap is the use of simplified linear figures together with repeated short-stroke rows, but these are generic graphic devices rather than a shared distinctive motif. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by long boat-like forms and stick anthropomorphic figures in an open composition, while B is organized in stacked registers of carved animal and emblematic forms with no comparable boat-and-human scheme.
